useCase: Preliminary screening for generado por IA content and post-processing detección
mechanism: Computes per-channel histogramas (R, G, B, Luminance) and analiza for gaps, spikes, periodicity, and smoothness metrics. Natural images have characteristic histograma shapes that differ from generado por IA content.
accuracy: Media - 70-82% como método independiente, mayor al combinar con otras señales
name: Analisis de histograma
parameters: Bins: 256, Channels: R/G/B/L, Metrics: kurtosis, skewness, entropía, gap count, periodicity index
description: Analiza color and luminance histograma distribucións for estadístico anomalías. generado por IA images often show unnaturally smooth or periodic histograma patrones.

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Statistical Tools for Digital Forensics. Information Hiding.
McCloskey, S. & Albright, M. (2019). Detecting GAN-generated Imagery using Saturation Cues. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Very fast computation
• Effective preliminary screening tool
• Detecta common AI histograma patrones
• Works a través de all image formats
limitations:
• Low standalone detección rate
• Post-processing easily alters histogramas
• Natural images can have unusual histogramas
• Color-corrected images produce falsos positivos
